research_rationale: The complete EO12813 text creates a new AID advisory commission; the prior statutory commission termination on May 16, 1992 is historical context, not this order’s ending. All functions, funding, compensation, administrative and FACA directions depend on the new Commission. Original §4(b) requires termination not later than September 30, 1992. EO12815 replaces that date with December 31, 1992; the immediate amendment directive has no delayed effective clause, so its September 30, 1992 execution is the amendment date by textual inference. The original date provision ends on amendment; remaining dependent commands cease under the amended express terminal date December 31, 1992. No supplied provision makes report completion itself an earlier terminating trigger. EO12869 §§4(b),6 formally revoke effective September 30, 1993, after the own-term ending. Adjacent Treasury regulation effective dates in the EO12815 context concern a different instrument. No independent executive command or savings clause survives; accrued travel reimbursement arises under the cited statute, not an ongoing commission mandate. The post-1937 OFR catalog/corpus search supplies bounded later-event coverage with both relevant actors held and no listed conflict or missing provision. No current-law/readiness assertion is made.
